# ReddTools

> Free, no-signup web utilities plus royalty-free music and wallpapers. Fast, ad-clutter-free tools that run entirely in your browser — no accounts, no downloads required.

## Tools

- https://reddtools.com/colour-picker: Image colour picker — drop an image and get exact HEX, RGB, and HSL values with a contrast checker
- https://reddtools.com/timer: Countdown timer, stopwatch, and Pomodoro timer with tab-title countdown
- https://reddtools.com/calculator: Multi-mode calculator for everyday math
- https://reddtools.com/calculator/mortgage: Mortgage calculator — monthly payment and total interest over the loan term
- https://reddtools.com/calculator/compound-interest: Compound interest calculator for savings and investments
- https://reddtools.com/calculator/simple-interest: Simple interest calculator for loans and investments
- https://reddtools.com/calculator/vat: VAT calculator — add or remove VAT at any rate (UK 20%, Spain 21%, Germany 19%, etc.)
- https://reddtools.com/calculator/percentage: Percentage calculator — change, difference, and totals
- https://reddtools.com/calculator/tip: Tip calculator with bill splitting
- https://reddtools.com/calculator/bmi: BMI calculator with metric and imperial units
- https://reddtools.com/calculator/loan: Loan calculator with amortization schedule preview
- https://reddtools.com/unit-converter: Unit converter for length, weight, temperature, volume, speed, and data
- https://reddtools.com/unit-converter/length: Length converter — metres, feet, miles, cm to inches
- https://reddtools.com/unit-converter/weight: Weight converter — kg to lbs, grams to ounces, stones
- https://reddtools.com/unit-converter/temperature: Temperature converter — Celsius, Fahrenheit, Kelvin
- https://reddtools.com/unit-converter/volume: Volume converter for cooking — cups to ml, litres to gallons
- https://reddtools.com/unit-converter/speed: Speed converter — mph, km/h, knots, m/s
- https://reddtools.com/unit-converter/data: Data storage converter — bytes, KB, MB, GB, TB
- https://reddtools.com/word-counter: Word and character counter with sentence count and reading time, live as you type
- https://reddtools.com/case-converter: Case converter — UPPER, lower, Title Case, camelCase, snake_case, kebab-case
- https://reddtools.com/contrast-checker: Colour contrast checker against WCAG AA and AAA accessibility standards
- https://reddtools.com/palette-generator: Colour palette generator from a base colour — analogous, complementary, triadic, monochromatic
- https://reddtools.com/px-to-rem: PX to REM converter with live reference table for any root font size

## Music

- https://reddtools.com/music: Index of 52 royalty-free instrumental tracks (ambient, folk, lo-fi, cinematic and more) — each track has its own page with a free MP3 download, playable and usable in personal and commercial projects

## Wallpapers

- https://reddtools.com/wallpapers: Index of 10 free high-resolution wallpapers (nature, abstract, typography) — free to download and use
